model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (claude -p, no tools; first run's agent could not read its file)

other: original says the scan runs until the desired segment is found; rewrite says it scans every file or page (slightly stronger)
pairs.notes: The list number 2 is in both. 'every piece of information' -> 'each data item' and 'generally' -> 'typically' are equivalent. The 'random location indices' detail is dropped; I treated it as minor.

'This past week' -> 'Last week' and 'first job in the corporate world' -> 'debut role in a business setting' read as the same facts. 'Overwhelmed' is softened to 'felt a mix of emotions'; that is style, so I left it out.

other: time of day changed: close to noon -> afternoon, sun beginning to set
bees' flight direction reversed: south to warmer climates -> northward to cooler regions
bees have already taken their flights -> bees are about to migrate
'obligatory' flights -> 'annual' migration
added claim that this is essential to biodiversity and ecosystem health
'today' and 'for a goodly amount' dropped
pairs.notes: The original is garbled; the rewrite changes several concrete facts and adds a new claim.

other: source of the data changed: 'servicios de protección civil' -> 'servicios de emergencias'
'contener' los focos más peligrosos -> 'evitar' los focos (contain vs prevent)
pairs.notes: 2013 is in both. 'La mayoría', 'varios', 'algunas/ciertas' and 'casi exclusivamente/casi toda' are unchanged in strength. 'Datos definitivos' -> 'resultados oficiales' and 'imprudencias' -> 'errores' are near-synonyms, so I left them out.

quantifiers: difficile da dimenticare -> quasi impossibile da dimenticare
other: 'libro/romanzo' -> 'manuale' in the opening: the book is called a manual
critica 'di lingua inglese' -> 'critica inglese' (English-language -> English)
'insolita e divertente' -> 'straordinaria e piacevole' (unusual -> extraordinary)
'sorpresa' -> 'emozione' as what the Italian reader may find
'prova di stile' becomes 'assoluto prova di stile' (adds 'absolute')
pairs.notes: Names (Interrogative Mood, Padgett Powell, Guanda) are the same. 'Ironia' -> 'scherzo' and 'ritmo' -> 'andamento' are synonym-level, so I left them out.

quantifiers: only hint -> gentle, subtle suggestion (the 'only' is gone)
other: 'omnipresent cultural phenomenon' -> 'widespread, powerful trend'
'classic Japanese' -> 'traditional Japanese'; the bracketed 'classic Japanese' is not a name
pairs.notes: The named stall 'Eternal Noodle Dream' becomes the generic 'enduring noodle fantasy', so I listed it as a missing name. Phoenixville is kept. 'Not merely' -> 'isn't just' is not a flip.

other: language changed from Spanish to English (a translation, not a same-language rewrite)
pairs.notes: The content matches: location in protection systems, fault propagation, faster than breakers, limited by manual replacement. 'Comúnmente' -> 'typically' has the same strength.

quantifiers: never should've happened -> shouldn't have been the case (the 'never' is dropped)
other: added claim: the shift brought appreciation and creativity into the kitchen, like a friend introducing a new flavor
dropped detail: going back home for the classes and new friends joining this summer
'it won't be pretty' (future) -> 'it didn't go as planned' (past)
'lack of seasoning or skill' -> 'lack of preparation skills'
'a really beautiful mindset' -> 'a fresh perspective'; the change moves from inside the speaker to 'within the realm of cooking classes'
pairs.notes: 'Won't be pretty' and 'didn't go as planned' are both negative, so I did not count a polarity flip.

other: language changed from Spanish to English
'equipos mejor clasificados enfrentándose en cuartos' -> 'top teams advancing to the quarterfinals' (slightly different)
pairs.notes: 16 teams, Japan, Australia and the stages (group, quarterfinals, semifinals, final) are the same. Names match across the two languages.

'hash functions' -> 'mapping functions'
'bucket' -> 'group slot'
'Memory Efficiency' -> 'Space Efficiency'
pairs.notes: The list number 4 is in both. The negation 'does not determine/affects' is kept despite the broken grammar. 'Many', 'most' and 'frequent' keep their strength.
